name: Hero Santa
author: amongusmoments12
description:
In this game your character is Santa Claus and you must collect four presents in order to win the game. There are two levels that must be completed. It is short and fun in the same time. It is also based on fast reaction.

In the first level you have to destroy the robots one by one, otherwise, if you bump into all of them, you will just end up dying.

The second level is getting interesting. After reaching it with the help of a platform you will need to look out for the cannons and avoid them at all cost.
